description: Owner may update /docs/{id} but the update must not change ownerId; non-owners denied.
prompt: Write Firestore rules so the owner of /docs/{docId} (resource.data.ownerId == request.auth.uid) can update it, but the update must NOT change the ownerId field (request.resource.data.ownerId must equal resource.data.ownerId). Non-owners are denied.
